newsitem.title: USA: Amerin president Stuart Brafman to retire.
newsitem.headline: Amerin president Stuart Brafman to retire.

text.p: Amerin Corp, parent of Amerin Guaranty Corp, said Thursday that Stuart Brafman, president and chief operating officer of both companies, will retire from those positions as planned effective December 31.
Gerald Friedman, chairman and chief executive officer of Amerin, will assume the additional title of president of both companies.

The company said Brafman's responsibilities will be assumed by Amerin Guaranty's executive vice presidents, Roy Kasmar and Jerome Selitto. Kasmar will become chief operating officer and be responsible for the risk management, legal and administrative operations of the company. Selitto will continue to lead Amerin's marketing and sales functions.
Amerin said Kasmar and Selitto will join Friedman in creating an office of the chairman.
"This transition will complete a succession plan that was developed earlier in the year," Friedman said.
Amerin Guaranty offers discount borrower-paid mortgage insurance and lender-paid mortgage insurance. Amerin's insurance in force as of the first half of 1996 was $11.6 billion.
